title: Sadaqah week planner
subject: PSHE
source: Written for pshe/y4 lesson 9 (Sadaqah week planner (pupil PDF))
intro: Lesson 9: Charity work: sadaqah and zakah. Read the ideas from the lesson, then do the tasks.

panels.title: Giving safely
points: Through trusted charities or the masjid
No collecting money from the public

keywords.def: the obligatory yearly charity on savings (زَكَاة)
the minimum wealth before zakah is due (نِصَاب)

questions.q: Name three kinds of sadaqah that cost no money.
questions.a: A smile, helping someone, kind words.

questions.q: A family has £1000 savings kept for a year, above the nisab. Zakah at 2.5%?
Core: Plan a 'sadaqah week' at home: one kind act or gift each day (pupil PDF).
questions.a: Seven sadaqah actions planned with a grown-up.

questions.q: Extend: Write how sadaqah and zakah are different in two sentences.
questions.a: Sadaqah is voluntary and any amount; zakah is obligatory, 2.5% of savings above nisab each year.

questions.q: Stretch: Explain why Islam makes zakah obligatory, not just optional.
questions.a: So the needy are always helped and wealth is shared fairly.
B) Zakah. Zakah is a pillar; sadaqah is voluntary (and always encouraged).

questions.q: Zakah is... A) 2.5% of savings above nisab B) 50% of all money C) only a smile
Big question: can you give sadaqah with no money?
questions.a: Yes: kind acts like a smile or helping are sadaqah.
